bug_semantics: OliveTin registered local-auth SIDs in server-side SessionStorage for about one year and authenticated requests that replayed the olivetin-sid-local cookie. Its implemented Logout flow expired only the browser cookie and did not delete the corresponding SID, so a copied pre-logout cookie remained accepted after the user appeared to log out; the eventual fix also revoked OAuth2's separate server-side state.
flaw_origin: Commit 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 is the smallest real BIC because it first implemented the advisory's exact vulnerable behavior: its new UI called Logout, and its Logout RPC returned an expired olivetin-sid-local cookie without revoking the already-authenticated provider/SID. The reviewer's earlier a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 added cookie-to-session authentication, but Logout at that tree was still a nonfunctional return-nil stub and did not clear a browser cookie; it supplied a prerequisite, not the post-logout bypass described by the advisory.
ai_marker: absent: `git cat-file -p 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0` shows one parent, human author and committer `jamesread <contact@jread.com>`, and only the subject `fix: User Information panel and login/logout flow`; the BIC commit object has no bot identity, Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, or other AI marker/trailer.
evidence: The bundled first-party GHSA-gq2m-77hf-vwgh defines the flaw as Logout clearing the browser cookie while leaving the SID in SessionStorage for about one year, then accepting a manually replayed old SID. It names fix d6a0abc3755d43107be1939567c52953bcbec3d5, patched pseudo-version 0.0.0-20260304233115-d6a0abc3755d15, and release 3000.11.1.

The disputed claims were primary 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 with parent 43cfe4137840cf52de95da8c2c15d217afc61148 versus reviewer a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 with parent 0dd9e9b2b7e9b8f3e9b0617efbe19c7ea267da85. `git show a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 -- service/internal/acl/acl.go` confirms the reviewer candidate added local-cookie parsing and GetUserSession acceptance, but `git blame -L 320,330 a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 -- service/internal/api/api.go` shows its Logout still returned `nil, nil`; `git grep` found only the legacy `/api/Logout` link and no frontend cookie clearing. Thus a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 did not yet implement the advisory's apparent-success clear-cookie-only logout.

`git show 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 -- service/internal/api/api.go` shows the BIC replacing the Logout stub with a response whose olivetin-sid-local cookie has MaxAge -1, without any SessionStorage deletion. `git blame -L 45,82 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 -- frontend/resources/vue/views/UserControlPanel.vue` shows the same commit adding the UI's `await window.client.logout({})` flow and post-logout reinitialization. `git log --all --reverse -S'MaxAge:   -1' -- service/internal/api/api.go` identifies 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 as the first local-cookie clearing implementation; the only later match, 7425db53f652b55d87449767176c8a3691b42601, added OAuth2 cookie clearing.

Direct-parent verification resolves introducer_parent and introducer_parent_absent: `git cat-file -p 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0` names exactly parent 43cfe4137840cf52de95da8c2c15d217afc61148. `git blame -L 328,340 43cfe4137840cf52de95da8c2c15d217afc61148 -- service/internal/api/api.go` shows only the Logout stub and `return nil, nil`, so the vulnerable clear-cookie-only logout is absent. The same parent already has a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9's cookie lookup/GetUserSession path, 3b8bc49b04d22aff94003e27725f60ff854d0a97's one-year RegisterUserSession/GetUserSession storage, and no revocation API, proving the BIC completed the advisory mechanism rather than merely importing or moving it.

The BIC is not a merge, squash wrapper, import, rename, or move: its commit object has one parent, and `git diff-tree --no-commit-id --name-status -r -M -C 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0` reports ordinary modifications plus newly added UI/config files, with the vulnerable API lines added directly in service/internal/api/api.go. No decomposition is required.

Version boundary checks support the resolved BIC: `git tag --contains 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0 --sort=version:refname` starts at 3000.1.2 and omits 3000.1.0 and 3000.1.1, while `git tag --contains a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 --sort=version:refname` starts at 3000.1.0 because that earlier prerequisite landed first. `git tag --contains d6a0abc3755d43107be1939567c52953bcbec3d5 --sort=version:refname` starts at 3000.11.1 and omits 3000.11.0, matching the advisory's fixed boundary.

`git show d6a0abc3755d43107be1939567c52953bcbec3d5` verifies the direct fix: Logout now calls `auth.RevokeSessionForProvider(api.cfg, user.Provider, user.SID)` before clearing cookies; the same commit adds local SessionStorage deletion/persistence and the OAuth2 revoker. This closes old-SID replay at the server-side trust boundary rather than changing only browser state.

BIC-only AI attribution was re-run with `git cat-file -p 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0`: the object has human author/committer jamesread, a plain one-line message, and no AI or bot marker. No PR text, branch name, later refactor, fix attribution, or other commit was used for the verdict.
reasoning: The primary claim wins both disputed fields. The reviewer correctly located when a local SID cookie first became an authentication input, and its proposed parent genuinely lacks that lookup, but that is not the vulnerability named and demonstrated by the advisory: at a7e7bf869ecbf87aa176337aac191e69bbcd90f9 there was no successful logout that cleared browser state, so there was no false post-logout security boundary to bypass. The direct child of 43cfe4137840cf52de95da8c2c15d217afc61148, 8686a5629e6a8fae3d99f2af0a3e8c3c0c37aae0, first added both the user-visible Logout call and the exact expired-cookie response while retaining the parent's one-year server session acceptance and omitting revocation. Its immediate parent lacks those vulnerable lines, the change is a concrete one-parent commit rather than an aggregate or move, and release containment begins at 3000.1.2. The advisory fix directly deletes the provider/SID and first ships in 3000.11.1. With a verified BIC, verified parent absence, verified direct fix, verified version boundary, and no BIC-object AI signal, the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
